notes.title: 🌟 Early Access Update 3.0.0.1 - Hopping Into New Dimensions! 🐰
notes.notes:
Dear Bunny Buddies,

We’re thrilled to bring you the latest enhancements in Early Access 3.0.0.1! Get ready to experience the game like never before with these exciting updates:

- UI Enhancements: We've revamped the user interface to make your gaming experience smoother and more intuitive. Navigate through menus with ease and enjoy a more polished, user-friendly environment.

- New 3D Lobby: Explore our new 3D lobby! Roam around and select your bunny in a dynamic and immersive way. The world comes alive as you gear up for your next big adventure.

- Bunny Sharing: Double the fun by selecting the same bunny as your friends! Bunny sharing is now possible, allowing multiple players to choose the same bunny character in multiplayer games.

- Three Brand New Levels: Discover three brand new levels, each packed with unique challenges and thrilling adventures. Prepare for hours of hopping good times!

- Improved Bunny Mechanics: Our bunny mechanics have been finely tuned for even smoother and more responsive gameplay. Jump, dodge, and race with enhanced precision and style!

- We’re eager to see you dive into these updates and explore all the new features. Don’t forget to share your experiences and feedback in our community forums!

- Ant Adventures: Get ready for some tiny but mighty new friends! We’ve introduced ants into the game, adding a whole new layer of fun and strategy. Watch as these clever little critters enhance your gameplay experience!

Hoppy Playing!
🐇💕
